delete from STL_SECP_RECON where CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y%m%d')
delete from STL_SEC_RECON_DEAL where TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y%m%d')
mapper.select:
SELECT FINPROD_ID, ENTRUST_TRADE_ID FROM STL_SEC_RECON WHERE (CHECK_RESULT = '1' OR CHECK_RESULT = '3')
AND SETTLE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{execDate},'%Y%m%d')

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(T1.SJRQ,'%Y%m%d') cdate, T1.QMYE zybs, CASE WHEN T1.BZ in ('0', '人民币') THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZ in ('1', '港币') THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZ in ('2', '美元') THEN 'USD' END jylb, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM INTERF_ZX_ZJYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH WHERE T1.SJRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT STR_TO_DATE(T1.JYRQ, '%Y%m%d') cdate, T1.ZJYE zybs, CASE WHEN T1.BZLB in ('RMB', '人民币') THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('HKD', '港币') THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('USD', '美元') THEN 'USD' END jylb, T2.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM INTERF_ZJYE T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO = T1.ZJZH WHERE T1.JYRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT STR_TO_DATE(T1.SJRQ,'%Y%m%d') cdate, sum(T1.CCSL) amout, T1.ZQZH acctNo, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END marketId, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, IFNULL(T3.CCY,'CNY') jylb FROM INTERF_ZX_GFYE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = CONCAT(T1.ZQDM,CASE WHEN T1.JYSC in ('0', '深圳') THEN '.SZ' WHEN T1.JYSC in ('1', '上海') then '.SH' END) WHERE T1.SJRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T1.JYSC IN ('0', '1', '深圳', '上海') group by T1.SJRQ, T1.ZQZH, T1.ZQDM,T3.FINPROD_ID,T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T3.CCY UNION ALL SELECT STR_TO_DATE(T1.JYRQ,'%Y%m%d') cdate, sum(T1.DQYE) amout, T1.ZQZH acctNo, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID END marketId, CASE WHEN T3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL THEN T1.ZQDM ELSE T3.FINPROD_ID END finprodId, CASE WHEN T1.BZLB in ('RMB', '人民币') THEN 'CNY' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('HKD', '港币') THEN 'HKD' WHEN T1.BZLB in ('USD', '美元') THEN 'USD' END jylb FROM INTERF_CCYE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = CONCAT(T1.ZQDM, CASE WHEN T1.JYLB in ('2', '深圳') THEN '.SZ' WHEN T1.JYLB in ('1', '上海') then '.SH' END) WHERE T1.JYRQ = #{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by T1.JYRQ, T1.ZQZH, T1.ZQDM,T3.FINPROD_ID,T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.BZLB

) resultData GROUP BY INSTRUCTION_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEAT_NUMBER, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, MARKET_ID, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_DATE, ACCOUT, SEC_ACCT_ID, CCY
